parameters.description:
`form-webhook-relay` accepts an HTTP POST with a native `form_webhook` payload. The gateway composes the upstream webhook URL from your stored secrets and forwards the request, so your credentials never leave the platform.

Two channels are available: the free `byok` channel uses your own stored credentials; the `plus` channel binds extra per-enrollment destinations via enrollment parameters.
parameters.summary: Relay a message to your own form webhook by posting a native `form_webhook` payload to the UnitySVC gateway.
